text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City shared her thoughts. She 
realized that until now, she had chosen 
her path either to meet the expectations 
of those around her, or simply to rebel 
against them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hadn't decided for herself. She 
explains that because she was truly an 
empty doll, she couldn't answer what she 
was running for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer explained that stepping away 
from running wouldn't be running away. 
Even so, she couldn't bring herself to say 
she would quit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer urged her to run with 
everything she had. Gold City ran in a 
total trance. And at the end of that 
all-out sprint, she realized something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if it hurts, even if it's painful, "I 
want to run"— That was, without a doubt, 
the reason she ran.
